svg.text: The essay funnels from cultural hype about conscious machines into a hub of psychological biases, then into four
independent arguments that converge on one verdict — real machine consciousness looks unlikely — which fans out
into two live ethical worries, and finally loops back, changed, to the opening worry about mistaking machines for…

g.text: Hype and bias feed the dream of conscious AI; four arguments converge against it; the practical fallout fans into two
risks that both lead back to a renewed, embodied sense of what makes us conscious.

g.title: Fantasies of conscious machines — Lemoine's LaMDA claim, 2022 — From Frankenstein to a Google engineer insisting a chatbot has feelings. — → spya-u6w37a
Why machine consciousness matters — It matters for AI welfare, for our own psychology, and for how we see ourselves. — → spya-e68t9h
Why AI seems conscious — 3 overlapping biases — Anthropocentrism, human exceptionalism, and anthropomorphism bundle intelligence with consciousness. — → spya-cvaqgs
Fluent language fuels illusion — Chatbots that talk well feel conscious; protein-folders that don't talk don't. — → spya-k6fpme
Exponential hype & tech-rapture — Every point on an exponential curve feels like the brink of transcendence. — → spya-cke6sj

Functionalism looks shaky — AI consciousness seems unlikely — → spya-uzr60x
Don't deliberately build conscious AI — → spya-e7fdmb
AI that merely seems conscious is risky — → spya-mxxutn
g.text: AI that merely seems conscious is risky

g.title: More breath than machine — soul as embodied awareness — Recovering an embodied sense of soul, against the mechanizing mirror of AI. — → spya-zv36xq

g.text: Each argument opens onto a concrete detail, and all four reinforce one guarded conclusion: machine consciousness is

g.title: Assumes computation suffices — Computational functionalism: the right information processing is enough for consciousness. — → spya-d3g67c

No software/hardware divide — A biological neuron can't be swapped for silicon without inventing a silicon metabolism. — → spya-b0086e
Steam valves aren't computers — The Watt governor regulates an engine with plain mechanics, not calculation. — → spya-sq9v5k
Perception ties mind to body — Conscious experience as controlled hallucination, rooted in keeping a body alive. — → spya-xhvztm
Simulated rain never gets wet — A simulation of X brings about X only if X is itself computational. — → spya-npjt4j
The arguments reinforce each other — → spya-nv6tp0

g.text: Two risks run side by side rather than forking: actually-conscious AI and merely conscious-seeming AI raise distinct,
equally live worries, both resisting any clean test.
